record.issue_text: addGuests.handler.ts:165 — updateCalendarAttendees runs unguarded after the DB commit with no try/catch, creating an unrecoverable partial-failure state where DB, calendar, and emails become inconsistent and retries are permanently blocked by the uniqueness filter

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the DB is updated first via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)`, and only afterward `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` is called with no `try/catch` or transactional rollback. If the calendar update throws, the booking already contains the new attendees, creating an inconsistent state (DB updated, external calendar not). A subsequent retry with the same guest emails will be blocked because `uniqueGuests` filters out emails already present in `booking.attendees`, leading to `uniqueGuests.length === 0` and a `BAD_REQUEST` (`emails_must_be_unique_valid`), preventing a retry of the calendar sync.
